lines: As time goes slipping by
I think of you
Two of us reflected on the screen I watch with weary eyes
We were smiling
Knowing more and more about you
More than I ever wanted to know
I was just swallowed up by the days drifting past
And even so
I wanted to see you just once more
The me who nodded at your words and believed
Left all alone as time moves on
The future I should have seen
Slipped right through the gaps between my fingers
Fragments of days I can't return to
And any trace of you
Even now I find myself searching for
Still reaching out my hand to the two of us from that day
I drew the boundary line myself
"That's just reality," I said
I was pretending not to see
A person like that
Couldn't see, couldn't see
The vivid flowers blooming
Beyond that boundary line
Even though I really could see them
Without ever realizing it
I locked the door of my worn-down heart
And inside there was only me,
left behind with nothing beautiful at all
The too-blue sky stung deep in my eyes
I'm going back to the scenery of that day
To the me you said you loved
Hidden away from everyone
The longing I concealed with these hands
Still lives on inside me
When I close my eyes
The scenery comes back vivid even now
And the fragments of days I can't return to
What they showed me was
A future locked away, still a bud
I'll draw it out once more
Your words from that day
And those beautiful hours
And the scenery we spent together
The longing I'd forgotten
Ties itself to the future I thought I'd lost
I'll walk on through
The rest of the days I can't return to
From here on, even without you
When I wave to the two of us from that day
It has truly begun to move
Toward the future
